PreToolUse.matcher: tool == "Bash" && tool_input.command matches "(uv run (manage\.py runserver|uvicorn|gunicorn|flask run)|python -m (http\.server|uvicorn|gunicorn))"

hooks.command:
uv run python3 -c "import sys; sys.stderr.write('[Hook] BLOCKED: Dev server must run in tmux for log access
[Hook] Use: tmux new-session -d -s dev "uv run manage.py runserver"
[Hook] Then: tmux attach -t dev
'); sys.exit(2)"

uv run python3 -c "import sys; sys.stderr.write('[Hook] BLOCKED: Use uv instead of pip install
[Hook] Use: uv sync --group <group> or uv sync --extra <extra>
[Hook] Example: uv sync --group docs --group dev
[Hook] Example: uv sync --group docs --group dev --extra cu128
'); sys.exit(2)"
uv run python3 -c "import os, sys; not os.environ.get('TMUX') and sys.stderr.write('[Hook] Consider running in tmux for session persistence\n[Hook] tmux new -s dev  |  tmux attach -t dev\n')"

uv run python3 -c "import sys, json, subprocess; d=sys.stdin.read(); i=json.loads(d); p=i.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); p and subprocess.run(['ruff','format',p],capture_output=True); print(d,end='')"

uv run python3 -c "import sys, json, subprocess; d=sys.stdin.read(); i=json.loads(d); p=i.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); r=subprocess.run(['ruff','check','--output-format=concise',p],capture_output=True,text=True) if p else None; r and r.stdout.strip() and sys.stderr.write(r.stdout.strip()+'\n'); print(d,end='')"

uv run python3 -c "import sys, json, subprocess; d=sys.stdin.read(); i=json.loads(d); p=i.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); r=subprocess.run(['ty','check',p],capture_output=True,text=True) if p else None; r and r.stdout.strip() and sys.stderr.write(r.stdout.strip()+'\n'); print(d,end='')"

uv run python3 -c "import sys, json, re; d=sys.stdin.read(); i=json.loads(d); p=i.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); lines=open(p).readlines() if p else []; matches=[(n+1,l.strip()) for n,l in enumerate(lines) if re.search(r' print\s*\(',l) and not re.search(r'#\s*noqa',l)]; matches and (sys.stderr.write('[Hook] WARNING: print() found in '+p+'
'), [sys.stderr.write(str(n)+': '+l+'
') for n,l in matches[:5]], sys.stderr.write('[Hook] Remove print() before committing
')); print(d,end='')"

PostToolUse.matcher: tool == "Bash" && tool_input.command matches "(uv run pytest|pytest|uv run manage\.py test)"

hooks.command: uv run python3 -c "import sys, json; d=sys.stdin.read(); sys.stderr.write('[Hook] Test run completed - review results above\n'); print(d,end='')"

uv run python3 -c "import subprocess, sys, re; r=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--name-only'],capture_output=True,text=True); files=[f for f in r.stdout.strip().split('
') if f.endswith('.py')]; found=False; [((matches:=[(n+1,l.strip()) for n,l in enumerate(open(f).readlines()) if re.search(r' print\s*\(',l) and not re.search(r'#\s*noqa',l)]) and (sys.stderr.write('[Hook] print() in '+f+':
') or True) and [sys.stderr.write('  '+str(n)+': '+l+'
') for n,l in matches[:3]]) for f in files if f]; any(True for f in files if f and [(n,l) for n,l in enumerate(open(f).readlines()) if re.search(r' print\s*\(',l) and not re.search(r'#\s*noqa',l)]) and sys.stderr.write('[Hook] Remove print() statements before committing
')"
